program_overview.title: Creative Media and Design for Teens
program_overview.tagline: Photo, video and design taught as one craft: eight honest months from first edit to a portfolio that looks like taste, not templates.
program_overview.description:
Teens live inside visual media; very few can make it well. This live online course for ages 13 to 18 teaches the full creative trio properly: photo editing from honest corrections to real compositing, video from cuts and rhythm to short productions with sound design, and graphic design from principles to a small brand built end to end. The final months add advanced video effects, real photography craft with whatever camera the family owns, and a portfolio capstone presented at demo day.

The toolkit is free-first and honest: strong free tools cover the entire syllabus, and industry options like Photoshop are taught as exactly that, options, for families that have them. There is no viral-chasing, no monetization coaching and no freelance pressure aimed at teenagers; the course builds craft and taste, the assets that actually compound.

The pace is real: eight months at two live classes a week plus two to three hours of practice, with two more months in hand when needed. Homework after every class, monthly mixed challenges, and a final exam, portfolio review plus a live editing task, that decides the certificate with a free retest. Real craft, real portfolio, depth over dopamine.

faqs.question: What will my teen learn and make in this course?
faqs.answer: The full creative trio across eight months: photo editing from honest corrections to compositing, video from cutting rhythm to an effects-and-sound short, graphic design through a mini brand built end to end, then real photography craft with any camera, and a portfolio capstone, a campaign across all three skills, presented at demo day. Sixty-plus critiqued pieces in total.

faqs.question: How long does it take to get genuinely good?
faqs.answer: Eight months at 2 live classes a week plus 2 to 3 hours of practice, with two more months in hand for teens who want longer. Creative skill is rep-based: the weekly critiqued pieces are the actual course, and the difference shows within the first month.

faqs.question: How is my teen assessed? Is the certificate just for attending?
faqs.answer: No. A piece follows every class, every month ends with a mixed challenge that revisits earlier skills, and the course ends with a final exam: a portfolio review plus a live editing task. Passing earns the certificate; falling short earns focused revision and a free retest.

faqs.question: Which software is used, and do we have to buy anything?
faqs.answer: Nothing needs to be purchased: strong free tools cover the entire syllabus for photo, video and design. Industry options like Photoshop are taught as options for families that already have Adobe access; every technique is also shown in the free equivalents, because the craft is the point, not the subscription.

faqs.question: Does this course teach growing on social media or earning as a creator?
faqs.answer: No, deliberately: no viral formulas, no monetization coaching, no freelance pressure aimed at teenagers. Craft and taste are what compound, and they are the whole syllabus. A teen whose work is genuinely good will never struggle for an audience later; the reverse is not true.

faqs.question: Does my teen need a good camera?
faqs.answer: No: the photography weeks are built around whatever camera the family owns, usually a phone, because composition and light matter far more than gear. The editing and design work needs only a normal computer.

faqs.question: What are the fees?
faqs.answer: Group classes are ₹1,499 per month, with 2 live classes a week in batches capped at 10 students. A mini batch of 3-4 students is ₹2,999 per month, and personal 1-on-1 classes are ₹4,999 per month. International students pay a price set for their own country, shown on this page in their local currency.

faqs.question: Is there a free trial class?
faqs.answer: Yes, a free demo class with no commitment: book at learn.modernagecoders.com/contact or message us on WhatsApp at +91 91233 66161. Your teen will edit something real inside the demo.

faqs.question: Are classes live or recorded?
faqs.answer: Live, always: small groups with a real instructor critiquing your teen’s actual work, never pre-recorded videos. Taste is built through critique, and critique needs eyes on the specific piece.
